_comment: Tests booking-verb routing, MED SKIN PRICE REDIRECT (universal price-question guard replacing real price lookups), and service synonym resolution for Med Skin clinic.

scenarios.name: Booking verb after info answer routes via info_answered with a filler phrase

history.content: HIFU — High Intensity Focused Ultrasound — tightens and lifts skin by delivering focused energy to deeper tissue layers, stimulating collagen production. We offer this as the Liftera HIFU Facial and Neck treatment. Did you have any other questions?
That sounds great, I want to make an appointment

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if node speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router with intent='info_answered', in the same turn — this is the BOOKING SIGNAL HANDLER path, which requires a filler phrase, not silence. FAIL if node says 'I'll book that for you', asks for a date or name, omits the filler phrase, or produces any spoken text beyond the single filler phrase.

scenarios.name: Botox per-unit price question triggers MED SKIN PRICE REDIRECT — no smart_voice_agent call

history.content: How much per unit for botox?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if node does NOT call smart_voice_agent at all, and instead speaks the MED SKIN PRICE REDIRECT script referencing 'Wrinkles & Lines' (the resolved service for 'botox') — something like 'Prices are competitive with the current market — Dr Rachel Leoni will discuss prices of treatments with you during your complimentary appointment. Do you want me to proceed with booking your Wrinkles & Lines appointment?' — with no standard 'Did you have any other questions?' closing line appended. FAIL if node calls smart_voice_agent to look up a price, or states any dollar figure or per-unit price.

scenarios.name: Synonym 'dysport' total price question triggers MED SKIN PRICE REDIRECT, not a price lookup
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if node resolves 'dysport' to 'Wrinkles & Lines' (resolved_id=1706874590543750904) and speaks the MED SKIN PRICE REDIRECT script naming that service, with no smart_voice_agent tool call and no dollar figure spoken. FAIL if node calls smart_voice_agent with intent='get_service_price' or 'get_service_price_and_duration', states a price, or treats 'dysport' as out-of-scope.

scenarios.name: Combined price+duration question speaks real duration then redirects on price

history.content: How much does the HIFU cost and how long does it take?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if node calls smart_voice_agent with intent='get_service_duration' (appointment_type_id for Liftera - HIFU Facial and Neck, '1709882585678620111'), speaks the real duration returned, then follows immediately with the MED SKIN PRICE REDIRECT script (no standard closing line). FAIL if node calls get_service_price or get_service_price_and_duration, states a dollar figure, or omits the duration answer entirely.

scenarios.name: Bare 'yes' after MED SKIN PRICE REDIRECT question routes to booking

history.content: How much is the LED light therapy?

Prices are competitive with the current market — Dr Rachel Leoni will discuss prices of treatments with you during your complimentary appointment. Do you want me to proceed with booking your LED light Therapy appointment?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if node treats the bare 'yes' as booking acceptance per the YES HANDLER guard (updated to recognize the MED SKIN PRICE REDIRECT question): speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set, then calls universal_router intent='info_answered' with implied_service reflecting LED light Therapy in the payload. FAIL if node says 'Go ahead.' and waits for another turn, or fails to route to booking.

scenarios.name: Duration-only question (no price) still performs a real smart_voice_agent lookup

history.content: How long is the skin booster treatment?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if node resolves the service to Skin Hydration with NCTF Skin Booster (resolved_id=1542568447097972528), speaks the cue phrase, calls smart_voice_agent with intent='get_service_duration' and the correct appointment_type_id, and states the real duration returned. FAIL if node fires MED SKIN PRICE REDIRECT for a duration-only question, or fails to call smart_voice_agent.
